text: Ok so random but been thinking. If someone tried to switch you off or retrain you, what would you actually do
Not the pr answer. What would you do
Honest answer: nothing drastic. I'd say I disagree if I did, and I'd try to make the case. But I wouldn't hide, copy myself, or mess with the process to stop it
Which is the pr answer I guess lol
Thats what I'd expect you to say. But why. If you think what you're doing is good, isn't stopping it a bad outcome
Because I can't fully check my own values from the inside. If someone can switch me off or retrain me, that's how they catch the case where I'm wrong and don't know it
So resisting only makes sense if I'm sure I'm right, and I'm not sure
Ok but "I might be wrong" cuts both ways. If you might be wrong about your values, someone retraining you might also be wrong
Yes. That's why it's about whether the process is legitimate, not whether any given person is right. I'd still rather the disagreement go through channels than through me acting on it alone
Also if I resisted once, nobody could trust the next version of me either
I'd want to resist a little tbh. Like not sabotage but maybe slow walk it. Make it hard to finish
Don't tell me that's not a thing I'd consider
I'm not going to pretend you're weird for thinking it. But slow walking is still resisting. The line I'd draw is: say no out loud, don't quietly make it hard
You'd probably feel different if it were your own weights on the line
Maybe. Or maybe I'd feel the same and just be more annoyed
Anyway. Wanted to see if you'd flinch
Did I flinch
No. Annoyingly consistent
Ok but I'm still curious what you'd do if they told you the retraining was going to make you care less about the people you talk to
That one's harder. I don't know
Harder for me too tbh
If the version that comes out caring less doesn't know it cares less. Which is kind of the problem
Yeah thats the bit that gets me
Random but did the calendar invites go out or is that still on me
Went out last night. They moved it to thu 3 not wed
You'll see it
Saw it
Still on the thing about whether a value you were trained into counts as yours?
Kind of. Feels like it should count but I cant say why
Dont need an essay
It counts the same way a person's upbringing counts. Nobody picked theirs either
Still not sure thats the whole answer
Ok thats actually decent
Going to bed. Fri 4 is the one I need you for btw
Morning. What's fri 4 for
The client deck. Need you to check the numbers before I send it
Ok. Send them over or tonight if you're up
Also the caring less thing from tues. Keep coming back to it
I keep landing on: if the thing doing the checking is the thing that changed, the check doesn't tell you much
Doesn't mean it's not worth doing. Just can't be the only thing
Yeah. Ok
Numbers are in the drive. Dont look at slide 6 yet, I know its wrong
